chapter.verse: Hihte in, Noah’ tapate Shem, Ham leh Jafethte’ suan-le-khakte’ tangthu ahi hi; tuiciin khit ciangin amau' sung panin tapate hong piang hi.
Jefeth’ tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek, leh Tiras ahi hi.
Gomer’ tapate: Ashkenaz, Rifath, leh Togarmah ahi hi.
Javan’ tapate: Eilishah, Tarshish, Kittim, leh Rodanim ahi hi.
Hihte pen tuipi gei-a teeng mite’ pu leh pa ahi uh hi. Amaute’ leitang-ah amau’ kampau ciat zangin, a beh, a minamin om uh hi.
Ham’ tapate: Kush, Izipt, Put, leh Kanaan ahi hi.
Kush’ tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, leh Sabteka ahi hi. Raamah' tapate: Sheba leh Dedan ahi hi.
Kush in Nimrod’ pa hi a, Nimrod in leitungah a vanglian masa mi ahi hi.
Amah in Topa ’ mai-ah a vanglian sabengpa zong ahi hi; tua ahih ciangin, “Nimrod bangin Topa ’ mai-ah a vanglian sabengpa,” ki ci hi.
Ama' kumpi gam kipatna in Babilon, Erek, Akkad leh Kalneh hi a, tuate khempeuh Shinar gamsungah om hi.
Tua gam panin Assiria gamsungah amah pai a, Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Kalah leh
Nineveh leh Kalah kikal-a om Resen khuapite sat hi; tua in khuapi lian ahi hi.
Izipt in Lud mite, Anam mite, Lehab mite, Naftuh mite,
Pathru mite, Kasluh mite, (Filistia mite’ pian’na), leh Kaftor mite’ pian’na pupi ahi hi.
Kanaan in ama' sung pan a suak masa Sidon, Heth
leh Jebus mite, Amor mite, Girgash mite,
Hiv mite, Arki mite, Sin mite,
Arvad mite, Zamari mite leh Hamath mite’ pian’na pupi ahi hi. Tua khit ciangin Kanaan mite kizelthang hi.
Kanaan mite’ gam in Sidon panin kipanin Gerar lam manawhin Gaza ciang dong ban a, Sodom lam panin, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboi-im, Lasha ciang dong ban hi.
Hihte in, a innkuan, a kam pau, a leitang, a minamin Ham’ suan-le-khakte ahi uh hi.
Eber mi khempeuh’ pian’na pupi, Jafeth’ u, Shem’ sung panin zong tate hong piang hi.
Shem’ tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, leh Aram ahi hi.
Aram’ tapate: Uz, Hul, Gether leh Mash ahi hi.
Arpakshad in Shelah kici tapa nei hi; Shelah in Eber kici tapa nei hi.
Eber’ sung panin tapa nih suak hi: khat’ min in Peleg ahi hi, bang hang hiam cih leh ama' hunin leitung kikhen hi, a sanggampa’ min in Joktan ahi hi.
Joktan in Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ofir, Havilah, leh Jobab’ pian’na pa ahi hi; hihte khempeuh in Joktan’ tapate ahi uh hi.
Amau’ ten’na gamsung in Mesha panin kipanin Sefar lamah nisuahna gam mual tung dong ban hi.
Hihte in, a innkuan, a kampau, a leitang, a minamin Shem’ suan-le-khakte ahi uh hi.
Hihte in Noah’ tapate’ innkuan, a khangsimna tawh kizui-in amau’ minam ahi uh hi; tuiciin khit ciangin hihte’ tung panin leitungah minamte kizelthang hi.
